derivation: Independent source facts and synthetic cases; no runtime imports or observed implementation decisions generated expected values.
scope: Bounded concept endpoints and junction constraints; overall normative conformance remains UNKNOWN.
schemaAuthority: Standalone oracle schema. Query shape matches planned evaluateConceptRelationship API; graph check names are semantic adapter labels, not required runtime ruleId strings.

c5.topic: Concept endpoints, exactly one source/target, relationship-to-relationship prohibition

composition.topic: Composition permitted in the same cases as aggregation

junction.topic: Same family, chain terminal permission, distinct incident relationships and incoming/outgoing degree

container.topic: Containing aggregation excluded from junction transit interpretation

plateau.topic: Plateau aggregation includes relationships and junctions

b6.topic: Source columns, target rows, family membership and endpoint qualifications

access.topic: Access modes share base family; arrows do not swap semantic endpoint roles

derived.topic: Permitted derived relation may be asserted directly

b5common.topic: Independent selected cell checks for graph terminal controls

b5implementation.topic: Deliverable to Process Realization is a target-eligibility witness

interpretation.PASS: Only the named bounded check passes; not whole-model conformance.
interpretation.FAIL: A definite violation in that check; must survive incomplete analysis elsewhere.
interpretation.UNKNOWN: Source scope, qualifier meaning, terminal coverage or analysis remains unassessed.
interpretation.overallStatusOmitted: Do not overconstrain aggregation of independent checked and unassessed scopes.
interpretation.symbols: Check subjects reference case-local symbol names; symbols maps them to actual UUID ConceptRefs.
interpretation.complete: Source-scope UNKNOWN can be a completely executed assessment. It differs from complete:false due to an analysis work limit.
interpretation.rawPreservation: All fixtures must be assessed without changing state, files, store history, endpoints or raw multiplicity.

metamorphicAssertions.transformation: Add/remove/repeat occurrences and connection drawings with the same model graph
metamorphicAssertions.expected: Equivalent model-level checks and terminal pairs.

metamorphicAssertions.transformation: Permute element, junction and relationship arrays
metamorphicAssertions.expected: Equivalent diagnostic facts and stable deterministic sorting; no forward-reference dependence.

metamorphicAssertions.transformation: Run a valid nontrivial case with a sufficiently small supported workLimit
metamorphicAssertions.expected: complete:false with explicit UNKNOWN coverage; no complete PASS or fabricated exact unevaluated-pair count.

metamorphicAssertions.transformation: Run with a workLimit that leaves incomplete coverage after a definite FAIL has been established
metamorphicAssertions.expected: FAIL remains a reported/aggregate failure; incomplete remainder is separate UNKNOWN.

metamorphicAssertions.transformation: Register a structured clone/lookalike instead of the original code-owned current profile
metamorphicAssertions.expected: No verified B.6 or graph normative authority; copied fields and matching ID/version are insufficient.
Private identity recognizer rejects the copy.

cases.note: Do not require a cycle-specific FAIL; passing bounded rules does not certify cycle instance semantics.
Function can realize Service; Process can be realized by Deliverable. Yet Function to Process has no R/r in the independently checked common-source cell.

checks.note: Uncertain exemption must not become definite mixed-family FAIL or full PASS

cases.note: No enum-string inequality prohibition; stored source/target roles never swap for ReadAccess.
